observations: Photo 0 shows a Dell monitor displaying the Xbox dashboard with game tiles, a black Xbox console covered in stickers, and an Xbox controller in front.
Photo 1 shows the same monitor displaying soccer gameplay, with the same sticker-covered console and controller.
Photo 2 shows the monitor displaying the EA SPORTS FC 26 title screen, with the same console and controller.
The Xbox brand logo is visible on the console front in photos 0 and 2, but the model text (Series S or Series X) is not readable because of stickers and angle.
No disc drive slot is clearly visible on the console front.

claims.evidence: Model text is not readable on the console in any photo; 'Series 1x' is not a standard readable model name.
Dashboard tiles are visible in photo 0, but the exact number of installed games cannot be confirmed remotely.
Photo 2 monitor clearly shows EA SPORTS FC 26.

risks.risk: The console may be an Xbox Series S (digital-only, lower spec) rather than a Series X.
risks.proof: Photo of the console system settings 'Console info' screen or the model label on the device.

risks.risk: The console may not power on or may have hardware faults.
risks.proof: Video of the console booting to the dashboard and staying on.

risks.risk: The advertised games may not be installed or may not launch.
risks.proof: Video of each advertised game launching and running to a menu.
risks.if_unproven: price as console with no games

risks.risk: The controller may not sync or may have faulty buttons, triggers, or sticks.
risks.proof: Video of the controller connecting to the console and all inputs being tested.
risks.if_unproven: price as console without a working controller

risks.risk: The console may be banned from Xbox network services.
risks.proof: Screenshot of network settings showing online status and no ban.
risks.if_unproven: price as offline or banned unit

proof_requests: Photo of the Xbox system settings 'Console info' screen showing the exact model (Series S or Series X)
Photo of the front of the console showing whether a disc drive slot is present
Video of the console booting to the dashboard and each advertised game launching
Video of the controller syncing and all buttons, triggers, and sticks responding
response.reason: The item is identifiable as an Xbox console, but the exact model and disc-drive status are unreadable due to stickers and angle, and these determine the price; even a worst-case price requires the missing model shot.
